mapper.select: SELECT t.name,t.end_at,a.end_at exam_end_at,t.assessment_id FROM training t LEFT JOIN assessment_task a ON a.id=t.assessment_id WHERE t.id=#{trainingId}

SELECT p.employee_id FROM assessment_participant p JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.participant_id=p.id WHERE p.task_id=#{taskId} AND a.id=(SELECT MAX(last.id) FROM assessment_attempt last WHERE last.participant_id=p.id) AND (a.status='PENDING_REVIEW' OR (a.status='SUBMITTED' AND a.passed=TRUE))

SELECT e.id,e.name,e.email,a.phone,a.candidate_name,a.department_name, (SELECT MAX(r.sent_at) FROM training_reminder_delivery r WHERE r.training_id=a.training_id AND r.employee_id=e.id AND r.status='SENT') last_sent_at FROM training_audience a JOIN organization_employee e ON e.id=a.employee_id WHERE a.training_id=#{trainingId} AND e.created_by=#{ownerId} AND e.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY e.id
mapper.update: UPDATE training_reminder_delivery SET status=#{status},message=#{message},sent_at=CASE WHEN #{sentStatus}='SENT' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END WHERE training_id=#{trainingId} AND employee_id=#{employeeId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
